facts.statement: Researchers built a web-based system called NIMP to manage how human brain tissue is turned into digital data while keeping a complete record of every step.
facts.subject: computational

facts.statement: The platform combines donor registration, anatomical labeling, tissue distribution, sequencing steps, quality checks, and data storage into one unified system.
facts.subject: computational

facts.statement: The authors state that this system offers a scalable and reusable way to manage resources with full history records and to generate data that is easy to find and share for future large projects.
facts.subject: computational
